items.name: Zauger ZX9 Semi-Automatic
items.notes: Standard issue polymer sidearm for UN Navy personnel and corporate security forces.

items.name: Alba Patera SAP 'Argyre'
items.notes: Martian high-muzzle-velocity heavy sidearm built for vacuum/armored engagements.

items.name: Zauger DI-C495 Pocket Pistol
items.notes: Easily concealable backup frame, highly favored by Belter rock-hoppers.

items.name: Nova Arms SAP34 Service Pistol
items.notes: A strictly mechanical, highly reliable baseline semi-automatic.

items.name: Star-Helix Security Issue Revolver
items.notes: Heavy kinetic cylinder revolver issued to atmospheric station marshals.

items.name: Martian Mag-Assisted Pistol
items.notes: Fires micro-flechettes using magnetic rails; highly effective in low-gravity vacuum.

items.name: Stunner Sidearm
items.notes: Non-lethal energy discharge weapon used strictly for civilian crowd or riot control.

items.name: Lou-Hi Tactical Systems Pistol
items.notes: Corporate-grade semi-automatic pistol favored by private security contractors.

items.name: Reul 52T Pistol
items.notes: Reliable sidearm with a distinctive profile, common in outer planet colonies.

items.name: Snow Tiger Pistol
items.notes: High-end civilian pistol known for its accuracy and precision machining.

items.name: Tyler Inc. Bolster Pistol
items.notes: Heavy-frame sidearm with a reputation for stopping power in close quarters.

items.name: Yoko-Tech Y-01 Pistol
items.notes: Mass-produced, modular pistol popular among Belters for its ease of repair.

items.name: 3D Printed Pistol
items.notes: Cheap, easily manufactured firearm of variable quality, common in the outer system.

items.name: 10guns Bach Revolver
items.notes: Classic design revolver, prized for its reliability in harsh environments.

items.name: Cold Iron 'Hyperdyne FR' Revolver
items.notes: Modern revolver with advanced materials, used by some security forces.

items.name: Edon Tech 'Chiasmodon' Revolver
items.notes: High-end revolver with integrated smart-link systems for targeting.

items.name: Korth NXR 'Nighthawk' Revolver
items.notes: Premium revolver, a status symbol among the wealthy and elite security.

items.name: Mateba Autorevolver
items.notes: Unusual semi-automatic revolver design, a collector's piece in the system.

items.name: 1st Generation Martian Service Pistol
items.notes: Early MCRN standard sidearm, based on the Springfield XD-9. Still seen in some reserve units.

items.name: 2nd Generation Martian Service Pistol
items.notes: Current MCRN sidearm, a modified Magpul FMG-9, known for its compact, folding design.

items.name: Standard United Nations Pistol
items.notes: Standard UN military sidearm, based on the Umarex Walther Red Hawk.

items.name: Protogen Security Pistol
items.notes: Sidearm issued to Protogen security forces, a modified Magpul FMG-9 similar to the Martian 2nd Gen.

items.name: Chiappa Rhino 50DS
items.notes: A powerful, distinctive revolver favored by UN black-ops tac-teams and later used by Detective Miller.

items.name: Vostok Firearms 'Zarya' MKII
items.notes: Bullpup, caseless ammunition SMG tailored for close-quarters ship boarding actions.

items.name: Edon Tech Bullpup 'Itajara'
items.notes: High-end corporate personal defense weapon featuring integrated smart-link telemetry.

items.name: Zarki Systems SamUC (Belter Stamped)
items.notes: Roughly manufactured, heavy-capacity SMG common in OPA cache networks.

items.name: MCRN Compact PDW
items.notes: Ultra-light personal defense weapon issued to Martian pilots and logistics crews.

items.name: 3Barrel PDW
items.notes: Unconventional three-barreled design, favored by some for its high burst output.

items.name: Black Rock Arms 12M PDW
items.notes: Compact and rugged PDW, popular among shipboard security teams.

items.name: HLG9i SMG
items.notes: Lightweight submachine gun with a high rate of fire, used by various factions.

items.name: TGA Repulsor DS SMG
items.notes: Advanced SMG featuring a unique recoil mitigation system.

items.name: Zarki Systems TimC SMG
items.notes: Simpler, more affordable variant of the SamUC, widely distributed in the Belt.

items.name: Behring AT XAR-55B Tactical Rifle
items.notes: Standard service assault rifle for United Nations Marines.

items.name: Alba Patera 'Tharsis II' Combat Rifle
items.notes: High-tier MCRN assault rifle featuring advanced carbon-weave recoil dampening.

items.name: Nova Arms AR34 Militia Rifle
items.notes: Older-generation kinetic rifle widely distributed across outer planet garrisons.

items.name: Nova Arms CS-48 Breaching Shotgun
items.notes: Pump-action combat shotgun devastating inside narrow metallic station corridors.

items.name: BMPS 42 Red (Low-Recoil Shotgun)
items.notes: Belter-modified gas-ported shotgun safe for untethered zero-g usage.

items.name: Edon Tech UCSRP 'Pike' Sniper System
items.notes: Long-range anti-material precision system built for moon-surface deployments.

items.name: MCRN Long-Range Marksman Rifle
items.notes: Smart-scoped semi-automatic rifle issued to marine scouts.

items.name: Edon Tech 'Akula Black' Anti-Materiel Rifle
items.notes: Heavy-caliber rifle designed to penetrate light vehicle armor and bulkheads.

items.name: Prototype 'Oceanic' Anti-Materiel Rifle
items.notes: Experimental long-range rifle, rarely seen outside of special forces.

items.name: Nova Arms S-4 Sniper Rifle
items.notes: Bolt-action precision rifle, a standard for planetary-based marksmen.

items.name: GR-Tech Fishman Sniper Rifle
items.notes: Semi-automatic sniper system with advanced environmental compensation.

items.name: Yoko-Tech 913-R Assault Rifle
items.notes: Versatile assault rifle, a common sight among various military and militia forces.

items.name: 3D Printed Assault Rifle
items.notes: Crudely manufactured rifle, often unreliable but easy to produce and conceal.

items.name: ThndrStrm SF43 Combat Shotgun
items.notes: High-capacity, semi-automatic shotgun for shipboard and urban combat.

items.name: Zulfiqar Double-Barreled Shotgun
items.notes: Simple, powerful break-action shotgun, reliable in the most extreme conditions.

items.name: UN Assault Rifle
items.notes: Standard UN Marine assault rifle, based on the H&K SL8-4, often seen in the hands of Amos and UN guards.

items.name: Martian Assault Rifle
items.notes: Standard MCRN Marine assault rifle, based on the APS UAR Airsoft rifle, a bullpup design.

items.name: Industrial Plasma Torch (Improvised)
items.notes: Heavy structural cutting tool that functions as a devastating melee weapon.

items.name: High-Output Rocket Launcher
items.notes: Man-portable military ordinance built to damage light ground vehicles or airlocks.

items.name: MCRN Recoilless Long-Gun
items.notes: Heavy, brace-mounted support weapon engineered exclusively for zero-g vacuums.

items.name: Chemical Tear Gas Launcher
items.notes: Atmospheric riot-control weapon used to clear hab-domes.

items.name: Creature Control Rifle
items.notes: Specialized weapon used by planetary surveyors for non-lethal animal control.

items.name: Goliath Powered Armor Minigun
items.notes: Built-in 2mm gatling gun for the MCRN Goliath Powered Armor, a devastating anti-personnel weapon.

items.name: Combat Knife
items.notes: Standard utility and fighting knife, common throughout the system.

items.name: Survival Knife
items.notes: Multi-purpose tool with a sturdy blade, essential for EVA and wilderness survival.

items.name: Heavy Axe
items.notes: A brutal and unbalanced melee weapon, often used for breaching or in zero-gravity fights.

items.name: Mace
items.notes: A crushing weapon, favored by some for its ability to deliver blunt-force trauma.

items.name: Sword
items.notes: A rare and balanced weapon, often a ceremonial piece or a personalized tool for melee specialists.

items.name: Flexible Weapon
items.notes: An unwieldy but unpredictable weapon, such as a chain or whip, used to bypass enemy defenses.

items.name: UN Navy Fragmentation Grenade
items.notes: Standard issue fragmentation grenade for UN forces. Effective in shipboard and urban combat.

items.name: MCR Navy Fragmentation Grenade
items.notes: Martian equivalent of the UN fragmentation grenade, with a slightly different blast pattern.

items.name: UN Navy Stun Grenade
items.notes: Non-lethal grenade used for crowd control and clearing rooms without causing structural damage.

items.name: MCR Navy Stun Grenade
items.notes: Martian version of the stun grenade, commonly used in boarding actions.

items.name: MCRN Prop Grenade
items.notes: A dummy or low-yield training grenade used by MCRN forces, sometimes repurposed as a decoy.

items.name: Mining Charge
items.notes: Industrial explosive used in asteroid mining, easily repurposed as a powerful demolition charge.

items.name: Nuclear Detonator (Prop/Device)
items.notes: A device for arming a nuclear warhead. Incredibly rare and restricted, with immense destructive potential.

items.name: Standard Civilian Clothing / Jumpsuit
items.notes: Basic, durable clothing suitable for shipboard life or dome cities.

items.name: Heavy Leather/Reinforced Work Coveralls
items.notes: Thick utility wear providing minor protection against stray industrial sparks.

items.name: Star-Helix Light Security Vest
items.notes: Concealable kinetic mesh vest designed to stop low-caliber handgun rounds.

items.name: UN Marine Tactical Body Armor
items.notes: Full-body composite plating issued to regular United Nations infantry forces.

items.name: MCRN Combat Armor Plating
items.notes: Advanced lightweight alloy plating optimized for both high-g and vacuum maneuvers.

items.name: Goliath Powered Armor
items.notes: Elite MCRN mechanical power armor; strictly military-restricted, self-contained system.

items.name: Light Carapace Armor
items.notes: Hardened shell armor providing solid protection without sacrificing mobility.

items.name: Bodyglove
items.notes: Skin-tight suit that offers minor protection and can be worn under other armor.

items.name: Flak Armor
items.notes: Soft armor designed to absorb shrapnel and fragmentation from explosives.

items.name: Mesh Armor
items.notes: Lightweight woven armor, offering good protection against slashing and stabbing attacks.

items.name: UNMC Powered Armor Space Suit
items.notes: Full-body powered armor suit used by United Nations Marine Corps, similar in concept to the Goliath suit.

items.name: Basic Emergency 'Bubble' Hood
items.notes: Single-use emergency transparent hood providing 10 minutes of filtration/oxygen.

items.name: Light Duties Skinsuit
items.notes: Form-fitting, low-profile internal suit designed to protect against brief decompression.

items.name: Standard Work Vacsuit
items.notes: The blue-collar industrial spacesuit used by Belter rock-hoppers for external repairs.

items.name: MCRN Armored Vacsuit
items.notes: A military-grade environmental suit with integrated kinetic mesh layers.

items.name: Standard Magnetic Boots (Mag-Boots)
items.notes: Ubiquitous footwear using high-grade electromagnets for deck-walking in zero-g.

items.name: Extended Oxygen Reservoir Tank
items.notes: Supplemental air supply tank attaching directly to standard utility suits.

items.name: Portable Emergency Vacuum Shelter
items.notes: Deployable inflatable hab-tent designed to shield up to 4 people from vacuum crashes.

items.name: Belter 'Pur & Kleen' Work Vacsuit
items.notes: A common, fabric-based vacsuit used by Belters, less protective than military-grade suits but widely available.

items.name: Hand Terminal (Consumer Grade)
items.notes: Ubiquitous transparent personal computer/phone used for localized data syncing.

items.name: Hand Terminal (Secure/Military Cryptographic)
items.notes: Hardened terminal featuring localized server-node encryption layers.

items.name: Mechanical Toolset (Shipboard Standard)
items.notes: Wrenches, drivers, and plasma-brazers necessary for keeping a hull together.

items.name: Electronic Sequencer (Lockpick)
items.notes: Illegal hacking bypass matrix tool used to splice electronic airlocks.

items.name: Industrial Laser Rangefinder
items.notes: Handheld survey device mapping geometry up to several kilometers out.

items.name: Remote Reconnaissance Drone
items.notes: Small Quad-rotor or cold-gas thruster probe equipped with optical sensors.

items.name: Mech (Exoskeleton)
items.notes: Bulky exoskeleton amplifying the wearer's strength for heavy lifting or combat.

items.name: MCRN Field Comm Device
items.notes: Standard-issue military communication device, a clear acrylic prop with a holographic interface.

items.name: Standard First-Aid Medkit
items.notes: Basic trauma dressings, topical sealants, and localized antiseptic sprays.

items.name: Automated Medical Injector (Auto-Med)
items.notes: Smart-sleeve computer attachment that diagnoses and administers stable drug cocktails.

items.name: High-G Cocktail ('The Juice')
items.notes: Essential chemical cocktail keeping pilots conscious during hard high-g maneuvers.

items.name: Anti-Radiation Drug Regimen
items.notes: Aggressive cellular repair pills crucial after exposure to leaking ship reactors.

items.name: Tissue Regeneration Gel Pack
items.notes: Synthetic biological slurry accelerating muscle and skin closing after kinetic wounds.

items.name: Ceres Station Field Medical Kit
items.notes: A standard-issue medical kit used on Ceres Station, containing supplies for common injuries and industrial accidents.

items.name: MCRN-Tachi Medical Backpack
items.notes: A high-quality medical backpack found on MCRN vessels like the Tachi, containing advanced field surgery tools and drugs.

items.name: Point Defense Cannon (PDC)
items.notes: Close-in weapon system firing rapid bursts of kinetic rounds to intercept torpedoes and fighters. Standard on military vessels.

items.name: Shipboard Torpedo (Missile)
items.notes: Guided ship-to-ship missile with a plasma or kinetic warhead. The primary offensive weapon for naval engagements.

items.name: Shipboard Railgun
items.notes: Electromagnetically fired kinetic weapon, devastating at short to medium range. Found on cruisers and battleships.

items.name: Grappling Cannon
items.notes: A shipboard cannon that fires a harpoon or grapnel to snare enemy vessels for boarding actions, found on some assault cruisers.

items.name: Breaching Pod
items.notes: Small, armored craft designed to attach to an enemy vessel and deploy marines directly into the hull.

items.name: Knight-Class Shuttle
items.notes: A small personnel shuttle with three fusion torch drives. Pre-Epstein drive technology, less efficient but common on older ships.

items.name: Grendel-Class Light Freighter
items.notes: A blocky, commercial transport spacecraft with four Epstein drives. Common for cargo hauling throughout the system.

items.name: Scirocco-Class Assault Cruiser
items.notes: A 200-meter long frontline warship and troop carrier, driven by four powerful Epstein drives. The pinnacle of combat balance.

items.name: Cronkite-Class Media Ship
items.notes: A specialty vessel designed for broadcasting and editing in deep space, a rare example of a ship built for a specific media role.

items.name: Raptor-Class Cruiser
items.notes: A dangerous warship with bow and stern railguns, six plasma torpedo bays, and advanced Epstein drives.

items.name: Colony Ship
items.notes: Large, long-range vessels designed to carry human colonists and supplies to the Outer Planets and beyond.
